text:
rachel-sales: Urgent: Velocity test for PayLink POC in 30m produced lots of 429s on embeddings. Need quick triage so demo doesn't flop.

bryan-eng: Paste a client error sample and headers? Which endpoint?

rachel-sales: From their test runner:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1600
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 45
Retry-After: 45
{"error":"rate limit exceeded","tenant":"paylink-poc","route":"/v1/embeddings"}
```
They ran ~45 concurrent small embeds (~50-90 tokens).

anya-ml: Pattern shows token-budget exhaustion on per-route window. UIs that fire per-item embed calls cause this. Short fixes: client-side batching, use multi-input embeddings, or temporary quota bump for demo.

oscar-ops: I can issue a temporary reservation. Suggest: per-route tokens/min -> 12000 for tenant paylink-poc, enable server-side queueing max_concurrency=8, TTL=3h. Will add audit note and auto-revert. Approve?

rachel-sales: Customer greenlit a temporary bump via DM. Also flag finance for potential overage.

quota-bot: quota-service: reservation applied id=resv_h4b7 for tenant=paylink-poc route=/v1/embeddings tokens_per_min=12000 ttl=3h by oscar-ops.

bryan-eng: After reservation I'm seeing queueing smooth the bursts. Recommend follow-ups: provide the customer a short client-side batching snippet, advise backoff+jitter, and propose a production plan (either reserved capacity or a proxy to aggregate calls).

anya-ml: I'll draft a one-page "embed demo checklist" with examples (multi-input call, batching code, model choice) for presales.

oscar-ops: Metrics saved; will revert at TTL unless extended.

rachel-sales: Rerun now  demo stable, occasional Retry-After but no disruptive 429s. Customer pleased. Thanks team.
